title: How AI is making music producers obsolete

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: Could AI tools one day replace the human touch in music production?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: AI can now auto-generate beats, mix tracks, and even emulate producer styles with tools like DeepMind's MusicLM and LANDR's mastering AI.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But this risks devaluing human creativity, eroding livelihoods, and homogenizing artistic expression across global music cultures.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are integrating human oversight, using AI as a collaborator—not a replacement—through hybrid workflows like AIVA and Splice's AI-assisted editing.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine AI handling the technical grind, freeing producers to focus on innovation and emotional storytelling in music.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future lies in harmony between human artistry and AI efficiency, reshaping music creation for the better.
